obs: Central National Bank v. United States

"but the law proceeds upon a presumption which disregards what is merely exceptional. And we have no hesitation in saying, that in inference to a dividend declared as of earnings for the current year and paid as such to stockholders, whether in money or in scrip, no proof would be admissible, for the purpose of avoiding the tax, that no earnings had in fact been made. The law conclusively assumes, in such a case, that a dividend declared and paid is a dividend earned."
